name: fold_start
description:
Opens a new trajectory fold for a sub-task. Returns fold_id to append REPL turns as the sub-task executes.

CALL WHEN: Starting any sub-task that involves multiple steps and whose results you want retrievable later. Always call write_plan_node first.
A fold is the durable equivalent of a REPL scope.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: fold_append
description:
Appends a REPL turn to an active fold. Returns current token_count.

CALL WHEN: After each step within an active fold.
MONITOR token_count: If it exceeds ~80000, open a nested fold for the next phase.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: fold_done
description:
Seals a fold with summary and embedding. Creates FOLDED_INTO graph edge to parent. Queues trajectory for compression.

CALL WHEN: When a sub-task is fully complete. Always call before returning from a recursive level.
Write summary as dense NL capsule: key findings, state changes, answers. Summarize outcomes, not process.
Cost: ~10ms.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: fold
description:
ANN vector search over prior fold summaries. Returns k most semantically similar fold summaries.

CALL WHEN: Starting a new task where prior work might be relevant. Also call when stuck — prior folds often contain relevant evidence.
RETRIEVAL LOOP: If results partially answer but leave gaps, call again with a more specific query targeting the gap. 2-3 rounds is normal.
Cost: ~10ms (HNSW). include_raw adds ~200-2000ms.

query.description: Optional text query for routing optimization. If provided, the router selects optimal k and include_raw.
